description: Versioned provider-neutral task and completion envelope contract. It defines bounded work and return information; it does not dispatch workers, select models, or grant filesystem authority.

path_rules: Paths are vault-relative, non-empty, and may not contain '..'.
A task with write_authority 'none' must not declare writable paths.
task_packet.manual_transport: A non-DTM worker uses the DTM Hand-Off skill to transport a completion packet to the active DTM thread; the packet does not authorise a Daily Note write.

dtm_handoff_projection.daily_note_implications: Daily Note implications for you to assess

completion_packet.manual_transport: When hand-off is required, send one concise DTM Hand-Off containing these fields and preserve the originating-thread checkpoint after delivery.
